I cut open the back of my beautiful leather theater seats and installed 2 tactile transducers behind each individual seat. These little devices are quite amazing and they simulate having a huge subwoofer right behind you except they are much more powerful than any subwoofer.

One of the best little-known upgrades you can do to your home theater for relatively cheap. These along with the powered subwoofers I have in each corner of the room give me a great home theater experience.

To operate the tactile transducer as you buy a separate little amplifier to power them and they hook them up right through your LFE (sub out) line on your main home theater receiver. Truly awesome to experience. Pic https://ibb.co/44F9DMy
